title: Manifest stops shippers paying for freight they never shipped

beats.claim: Manifest stops shippers paying for freight they never shipped
beats.notes:
- Thanks for the time. We’re Manifest, and we audit every freight invoice before it gets paid.
- We’re raising a $4M seed to take what worked in our pilots to the mid-market.
- Fifteen minutes: the problem, what it costs, why today’s fixes fail, and what we built.

narrato.purpose: Names the company and the promise in one line
narrato.intent: Make them curious why freight invoices need auditing
narrato.visual: A loading dock at dawn, trucks backed into bays, a single invoice glowing on a tablet in the foreground

beats.claim: One in twelve freight invoices is wrong, and nobody checks
beats.notes:
- Here’s the uncomfortable truth we found in every pilot.
- About 8% of freight invoices carry an error, almost always in the carrier’s favor.
- A shipper moving 20,000 loads a year can’t read every line, so they don’t.
- They pay what they’re billed and hope the carrier got it right.

narrato.purpose: States the core problem as a single hard fact
narrato.intent: Make them feel the scale of unchecked overbilling
narrato.visual: A stack of thousands of invoices on a desk, one highlighted in red, the rest blurring into shadow

beats.claim: Billing errors drain $9 billion from US shippers every year
beats.notes:
- We took the error rate from 2.1 million invoices we audited and applied it to US freight spend.
- That’s $9 billion a year, paid and never recovered.
- For a typical mid-market shipper, that’s $400K to $1.2M walking out the door.
- And nobody on their team owns finding it.

narrato.purpose: Quantifies the cost of inaction with a single dollar figure
narrato.intent: Make them feel that ignoring this is itself expensive
narrato.visual: A single enormous dollar figure over a highway at night, trucks streaking past as light trails
narrato.fact: Manifest analysis of 2.1M invoices from 38 pilot shippers, applied to $1.1T US freight spend

beats.claim: Accessorial charges cause most of the overbilling we found
beats.notes:
- Accessorials are the extras: liftgates, detention, residential delivery.
- They’re billed after the fact and rarely match the contract.
- Duplicates are next: the same load billed twice through two channels.
- Rate drift is the quiet one: last year’s rate, this year’s invoice.

narrato.purpose: Shows where the money leaks so the problem feels concrete
narrato.intent: Make them believe the errors are systematic, not random

beats.claim: We knew we were overpaying but couldn’t afford to find out
beats.notes: Dana runs logistics for a $600M food distributor. Before Manifest, her team of four sampled two hundred invoices a month out of nine thousand. She knew the money was there; she had no way to get it without hiring an audit firm that would take a third of it.

narrato.purpose: Gives the problem a human voice from a real buyer
narrato.intent: Make them feel the buyer's frustration with the status quo
narrato.visual: Portrait of a logistics manager in a warehouse office, invoices pinned to a corkboard behind her

beats.claim: Audit firms recover money months late and keep a third of it
beats.notes:
| | Audit firms | Manifest |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Speed | 45–60 days after payment | Before payment |
| Cost | 30–50% contingency | Flat per-invoice fee |
| Coverage | Sampled | Every invoice |

narrato.purpose: Shows why the incumbents cannot fix this
narrato.intent: Make them see a gap the incumbents structurally cannot close

sections.title: Audit every invoice before it is paid

beats.claim: Audit every invoice before it is paid
beats.notes:
- So we built the audit that happens before the money moves.
- Let me show you how it works.

narrato.purpose: Turns the deck from problem to solution
narrato.intent: Signal that the answer is coming
narrato.visual: A single invoice on a dark background, a green check mark drawing itself across it

beats.claim: Manifest checks each invoice against the contract in seconds
beats.notes:
- Three steps, all automatic.
- We read every invoice format carriers send, including scanned PDFs.
- We match each charge to the contract and to what actually happened on the dock.
- When something’s wrong, we file the dispute with evidence attached.
- AP only ever sees verified amounts.

narrato.purpose: Explains the mechanism so the claim feels credible
narrato.intent: Make them believe the product is real and simple to adopt
narrato.visual: A clean three-panel diagram: an invoice, a contract, and a dispute email connected by glowing lines

beats.claim: Audit moves from months after payment to seconds before it
beats.notes:
- This is the shift that matters.
- Recovery after payment is slow, adversarial, and expensive.
- Prevention before payment is fast and the carrier usually just reissues the invoice.
- Our pilots disputed before payment 94% of the time.

narrato.purpose: Shows the transformation in one comparison
narrato.intent: Make them feel how much better prevention is than recovery

beats.claim: Pilots recovered 4.2% of freight spend within 90 days
beats.notes:
- These are paid pilots, not free trials.
- 4.2% of spend recovered is real money: $840K for a shipper spending $20M.
- We’ve audited 2.1 million invoices, so the error rates aren’t a fluke.
- Carriers accept 97% of our disputes because we attach the evidence.

narrato.purpose: Proves the product works with hard numbers
narrato.intent: Make them believe the results are repeatable

beats.claim: ARR grew fivefold this year to $910K
beats.notes:
- We converted 31 of 38 pilots to annual contracts.
- Growth has come entirely from referrals and two logistics conferences.
- No paid acquisition yet; that’s part of what this round funds.
- Net revenue retention is 138% because customers add carriers and sites.

narrato.intent: Make them feel momentum they want to be part of

beats.claim: A $2.4B market sits inside mid-market freight spend
beats.notes:
- We start with mid-market shippers, $10M to $200M in freight spend.
- They’re too small for the big audit firms and too big to check by hand.
- 4,200 of them already exchange EDI with the top carriers, so onboarding is days, not months.
- That’s a $2.4B revenue opportunity before we touch enterprise.

narrato.intent: Make them believe the market can support a large company

beats.claim: Built by people who ran freight audit at scale
beats.notes:
- Priya ran audit at Flexport and saw the same errors at every customer.
- Marcus built Stripe’s reconciliation engine, which is the same matching problem at a different scale.
- Jen has sold to exactly the buyers we’re selling to.
- We’ve worked together on and off for eight years.

narrato.intent: Make them trust this team to execute

beats.claim: We’re raising $4M to reach $5M ARR by end of 2027
beats.notes:
- We’re raising $4M on a $20M post-money SAFE.
- It gets us 18 months and 120 shippers, which is $5M ARR.
- Most of it goes to engineering: more carrier formats, more contract types.
- We have $1.5M committed and want a lead who knows supply chain.

narrato.purpose: Makes the explicit request with terms
narrato.intent: Make them want to lead the round

beats.claim: Every freight invoice checked before it is paid
beats.notes:
- That’s Manifest: every invoice checked before it’s paid.
- We’d love to have you in the round.
- Happy to share the pilot data room after this call.

narrato.purpose: Lands the promise and the contact
narrato.intent: Make them remember the one-line promise
narrato.visual: The loading dock from the cover, now at full daylight, trucks departing
